name: Ryley Robinson (Subnautica) as Aphelios
creator: frehlty
description:
## Info

This mod changes the VFX, SFX and models of the og Aphelios into the themes of the Main character from Subnautica Ryley Robinson. Voice lines are changed to PDA and The Sea Emperor Leviathan.

## Weapons

Calibrum - Stasis Gun
Severum - Heat Knife
Gravitum - Propulsion Gun
Infernum - Gasopod
Crescendum - Boomerang (Fish)


*Enjoy :)*
